item.title: September Update
item.description:
I just came back from a two weeks vacation in France with my daughter, and without my laptop, which was pretty nice. As a result I don’t have much to say for this month !

After coming back I had an idea for a small project, a “guess who” app that I vibecoded in a few hours with Firebase Studio. It got me a Next.js+tailwindcss app pretty quickly, with LLM calls handled by Genkit. Originally it was using the Gemini API and hosted on Firebase, but I’ve changed it to GPT-5 and Fly.io for hosting.
